HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
Give your HVAC filter a back-to-routine check.

With daily routines settling back in, this is a good week to check the filter and airflow around your heating and cooling system.

  • Inspect the filter and replace it if it is dirty or due under the manufacturer's schedule.
  • Keep supply and return vents clear of furniture, rugs, and curtains.
  • If you notice unusual noise, weak airflow, or moisture, contact a qualified HVAC professional.

Source
